answer: Each identity files one voyage log of ports, cargo and times as its fingerprint. Auditors recheck the voyage on the public log; rented-voyage ring, impossible route, or copied log burns the bond; an umber seal binds each log to its key. The 70-credit bond waits in a vault, unlocking after a clean epoch. First 40, the k-th 40+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 plus 70,000 locked; one honest agent pays 40 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
